name: DEAD · AIR
source:
Despite her best efforts, Sid is the least equip to handle any of this.  But when she sees something she clearly wasn't supposed to, what else can she really do but get involved?

[From [url=https://thankyouthankyou.itch.io/dead-air]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
尽管已经竭尽全力，西德（Sid）依然是最没本事应付眼下这摊烂账的人。可当她亲眼撞见了显然绝不该由她看到的一幕时，除了硬着头皮卷入其中，她还能怎么办呢？

[摘自[url=https://thankyouthankyou.itch.io/dead-air]itch.io[/url]]
